translations.literal: (Auspicious Rites 6)〉

sentences.zh: 奉先殿 奉慈殿 獻皇帝廟 新王從饗 功臣配饗 王國宗廟 羣臣家廟

translations.literal: Hall of Ancestors; Hall of Maternal Kindness; Temple of the Offering Emperor; joint offerings for new princes; matching offerings for meritorious ministers; ancestral temples of princely states; family temples of officials
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Ancestors; the Hall of Maternal Kindness; the Temple of the Offering Emperor; joint offerings for newly enfeoffed princes; matching offerings for meritorious ministers; ancestral temples of princely domains; and family temples of the official class

sentences.zh: ○奉先殿

translations.literal: ○ Hall of Ancestors
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Hall of Ancestors

sentences.zh: 洪武三年，太祖以太廟時享，未足以展孝思，復建奉先殿於宮門內之東。

translations.literal: In the third year of Hongwu, because the seasonal offerings at the Grand Ancestral Temple were not sufficient to express filial devotion, the Taizu again built the Hall of Ancestors to the east inside the palace gate.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of the Hongwu reign, the Taizu found that the periodic offerings at the Grand Ancestral Temple did not fully satisfy his filial devotion, and therefore built the Hall of Ancestors anew on the east side within the palace gates.

sentences.zh: 以太廟象外朝，以奉先殿象內朝。

translations.literal: The Grand Ancestral Temple represented the outer court; the Hall of Ancestors represented the inner court.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Ancestral Temple stood for the outer court, and the Hall of Ancestors for the inner court.

sentences.zh: 正殿五間，南向，深二丈五尺。

translations.literal: The main hall had five bays, facing south, with a depth of two zhang and five chi.
translations.idiomatic: The main hall had five bays facing south, twenty-five chi in depth.

sentences.zh: 前軒五間，深半之。

translations.literal: The front veranda had five bays, with a depth half that of the main hall.
translations.idiomatic: The front veranda had five bays, half the depth of the main hall.

sentences.zh: 制四代帝后神位、衣冠，定儀物、祝文。

translations.literal: Spirit tablets and vestments for four generations of emperors and empresses were made, and ritual objects and prayer texts were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit tablets and vestments for four generations of emperors and empresses were fashioned, and ritual implements and prayer texts were prescribed.

sentences.zh: 每日朝晡，帝及皇太子諸王二次朝享。

translations.literal: Each day at morning and evening, the emperor together with the crown prince and princes paid court and offered sacrifice twice.
translations.idiomatic: Morning and evening each day, the emperor, the crown prince, and the princes attended twice to pay homage and offer sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 皇后率嬪妃日進膳羞，諸節致祭，月朔薦新，其品物視元年所定。

translations.literal: The empress led the consorts to present food daily; at the various festivals sacrifices were made, and at the new moon of each month fresh offerings were presented—the items being as fixed in the founding year.
translations.idiomatic: The empress led the consorts in presenting daily meals; sacrifices were offered at the seasonal festivals, and fresh produce was presented at each new moon, all according to the list fixed in the founding year.

sentences.zh: 惟三月不用鮆魚，四月減鰣魚，益以王瓜彘，五月益以茄，九月減柿蟹，十月減木瓜蘆菔，益以山藥，十一月減天鵝鶿老，益以麞。

translations.literal: Only in the third month shad was not used; in the fourth month shad was reduced and wax gourd and pig were added; in the fifth month eggplant was added; in the ninth month persimmon and crab were reduced; in the tenth month papaya and radish were reduced and Chinese yam was added; in the eleventh month swan, cormorant, and dried fish were reduced and roe deer was added.
translations.idiomatic: In the third month shad was omitted; in the fourth the shad offering was reduced and wax gourd and pork were added; in the fifth eggplant was added; in the ninth persimmon and crab were reduced; in the tenth papaya and radish were reduced and Chinese yam was added; in the eleventh swan, cormorant, and dried fish were reduced and roe deer was added.

sentences.zh: 皆太常奏聞，送光祿寺供薦。

translations.literal: All were reported by the Court of Imperial Sacrifices and sent to the Court of Imperial Entertainments to supply the offerings.
translations.idiomatic: In every case the Court of Imperial Sacrifices reported to the throne, and the Court of Imperial Entertainments supplied the offerings.

sentences.zh: 凡遇時新品物，太常供獻。

translations.literal: Whenever seasonal fresh products appeared, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices presented them as offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Whenever new seasonal products appeared, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices furnished them for presentation.

sentences.zh: 又錄皇考妣忌日，歲時享祀以爲常。

translations.literal: The death anniversaries of the emperor’s father and mother were also recorded, and annual sacrifices were performed as a regular practice.
translations.idiomatic: The death anniversaries of the imperial father and mother were also recorded, and yearly sacrifices were established as a standing observance.

sentences.zh: 成祖遷都北京，建如制。

translations.literal: When Chengzu moved the capital to Beijing, a hall was built according to the same regulations.
translations.idiomatic: When the Chengzu transferred the capital to Beijing, a hall was built to the same design.

sentences.zh: 宣德元年，奉太宗祔廟畢，復遣鄭王瞻颭詣奉先殿，設酒果祭告，奉安神位。

translations.literal: In the first year of Xuande, after Taizong was enshrined in the ancestral temple, the Prince of Zheng Zhu Zhan’en was again dispatched to the Hall of Ancestors to set out wine and fruit for a sacrificial announcement and to install the spirit seat in peace.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Xuande, after Taizong had been enshrined in the ancestral temple, the Prince of Zheng Zhu Zhan’en was again sent to the Hall of Ancestors to set out wine and fruit, announce the sacrifice, and install the spirit seat.

sentences.zh: 天順七年，奉孝恭皇后祔廟畢，帝還行奉安神位禮，略如祔廟儀。

translations.literal: In the seventh year of Tianshun, after Empress Xiaogong was enshrined in the temple, the emperor again performed the rite of installing the spirit seat in peace, broadly following the enshrinement rite.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh year of Tianshun, after Empress Xiaogong had been enshrined in the temple, the emperor again performed the rite of installing the spirit seat, largely following the enshrinement ceremony.

sentences.zh: 弘治十七年，吏部尚書馬文升言：「南京進鮮船，本爲奉先殿設。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Hongzhi, Minister of Personnel Ma Wensheng said: “The Nanjing fresh-tribute boats were originally established for the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Hongzhi, Minister of Personnel Ma Wensheng said: “The fresh-tribute boats from Nanjing were originally set up for the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 輓夫至千人，沿途悉索。

translations.literal: The bearers of the bier reached a thousand men, and along the route they extorted everything.
translations.idiomatic: The bier-bearers numbered as many as a thousand, and all along the route they demanded whatever they wished.

sentences.zh: 今揚、徐荒旱，願仿古凶年殺禮之意，減省以蘇民困。

translations.literal: Now Yang and Xu are stricken by drought; we wish to follow the ancient idea of reducing rites in years of disaster, and cut back expenditures to relieve the people’s distress.”
translations.idiomatic: Yang and Xu are now afflicted by drought and famine; we ask to follow the ancient practice of curtailing rites in calamitous years and reduce these outlays to ease the people’s hardship.”

sentences.zh: 」命所司議行之。

translations.literal: ” He ordered the responsible offices to deliberate and carry it out.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor ordered the relevant offices to deliberate and implement the proposal.

sentences.zh: 武宗即位，祧熙祖。

translations.literal: When Wuzong took the throne, Xizu was removed from the line of succession.
translations.idiomatic: When the Wuzong acceded, Xizu was displaced from the ancestral line.

sentences.zh: 奉先殿神位亦遷德祖之西，其衣冠、牀幔、儀物貯於神庫。

translations.literal: The spirit tablets of the Hall of Ancestors were also moved to the west of Dezu, and their vestments, bed curtains, and ritual objects were stored in the spirit treasury.
translations.idiomatic: The spirit tablets in the Hall of Ancestors were also moved to the west of Dezu, and their vestments, bed hangings, and ritual objects were placed in the spirit treasury.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十四年，定內殿之祭並禮儀。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Jiajing, the sacrifices of the inner halls and their ritual procedures were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Jiajing, the sacrifices of the inner halls and their ceremonial order were prescribed.

sentences.zh: 清明、中元、聖誕、冬至、正旦，有祝文，樂如宴樂。

translations.literal: At Qingming, Zhongyuan, the imperial birthday, the winter solstice, and New Year’s Day there were prayer texts, and music like that of a banquet.
translations.idiomatic: At Qingming, Zhongyuan, the imperial birthday, the winter solstice, and New Year’s Day there were prayer texts, with music like that used at banquets.

sentences.zh: 兩宮壽旦，皇后並妃嬪生日，皆有祭，無祝文、樂。

translations.literal: On the birthdays of the two palaces, the empress, and the consorts together, sacrifices were held without prayer texts or music.
translations.idiomatic: On the birthdays of the two palaces, the empress, and all the consorts, sacrifices were held but without prayer texts or music.

sentences.zh: 立春、元宵、四月八日、端陽、中秋、重陽、十二月八日，皆有祭，用時食。

translations.literal: At the Beginning of Spring, the Lantern Festival, the eighth day of the fourth month, the Dragon Boat Festival, Mid-Autumn, Double Yang, and the eighth day of the twelfth month, sacrifices were all held using seasonal foods.
translations.idiomatic: At the Beginning of Spring, the Lantern Festival, the eighth day of the fourth month, the Dragon Boat Festival, Mid-Autumn, Double Yang, and the eighth day of the twelfth month, sacrifices were offered with seasonal foods.

sentences.zh: 舊無祝文，今增告詞。

translations.literal: Formerly there were no prayer texts; now announcement words were added.
translations.idiomatic: Previously there had been no prayer texts; announcement formulas were now added.

sentences.zh: 舊儀，但一室一拜，至中室跪祝畢，又四拜，焚祝帛。

translations.literal: In the old rite one bowed once in each chamber; upon reaching the central chamber one knelt, finished the prayer, bowed four times again, and burned the prayer silks.
translations.idiomatic: Under the old rite one bowed once in each chamber; upon reaching the central chamber one knelt, completed the prayer, bowed four times again, and burned the prayer silks.

sentences.zh: 今就位四拜，獻帛爵，祝畢，后妃助亞獻，執事終獻，撤饌又四拜。

translations.literal: Now upon taking position one bowed four times, presented silks and libation cups, and when the prayer was finished the empress and consorts assisted in the secondary offering, the attendants made the final offering, and after the viands were removed one bowed four times again.
translations.idiomatic: Now one bowed four times upon taking position, presented silks and libation cups, and when the prayer was finished the empress and consorts assisted in the secondary offering, the attendants performed the final offering, and after the viands were cleared away one bowed four times again.

sentences.zh: 忌祭，舊具服作樂，今更淺色衣，去樂。

translations.literal: For death-anniversary sacrifices, formerly full dress and music were used; now lighter-colored garments were worn and music was removed.
translations.idiomatic: For death-anniversary sacrifices, formerly full mourning dress and music had been used; now lighter-colored garments were worn and music was omitted.

sentences.zh: 凡祭方澤、朝日夕月，出告、回參，及冊封告祭，朔望行禮，皆在焉。

translations.literal: All sacrifices to the Square Mound, the morning sun and evening moon, departure announcements, return presentations, enfeoffment announcements, and new- and full-moon observances were conducted there.
translations.idiomatic: All sacrifices at the Square Mound, to the morning sun and evening moon, departure announcements, return presentations, enfeoffment announcements, and new- and full-moon rites were performed there.

sentences.zh: 十五年，禮部尚書夏言等奏：「悼靈皇后神主，先因祔於所親，暫祔奉慈殿孝惠太后之側。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, Minister of Rites Xia Yan and others memorialized: “The spirit tablet of Empress Daoling was first, because of enshrinement with her kin, temporarily placed beside Empress Xiaohui in the Hall of Maternal Kindness.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, Minister of Rites Xia Yan and others memorialized: “The spirit tablet of Empress Daoling had first, because she was enshrined with her own kin, been placed temporarily beside Empress Xiaohui in the Hall of Maternal Kindness.

sentences.zh: 茲三後神主既擬遷於陵殿，則悼靈亦宜暫遷奉先殿旁室，享祀祭告，則一體設饌。

translations.literal: Now that the spirit tablets of the three empresses are to be moved to the mausoleum hall, Daoling should also be temporarily moved to a side chamber of the Hall of Ancestors; for offerings, announcements, and sacrifices, a single set of viands should be prepared.”
translations.idiomatic: Now that the spirit tablets of the three empresses are to be moved to the mausoleum hall, Daoling should likewise be moved temporarily to a side chamber of the Hall of Ancestors; for offerings, announcements, and sacrifices, one and the same set of viands should be prepared.”

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ” The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，禮部言：「舊制，太廟一歲五享，而節序忌辰等祭，則行於奉先殿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing, the Ministry of Rites said: “Under the old system the Grand Ancestral Temple held five offerings a year, while seasonal and death-anniversary sacrifices were performed at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing, the Ministry of Rites said: “Under the former system the Grand Ancestral Temple received five offerings a year, whereas seasonal and death-anniversary sacrifices were performed at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 今孝潔皇后既祔太廟，則奉先殿亦宜奉安神位。

translations.literal: Now that Empress Xiaojie has been enshrined in the Grand Temple, the Hall of Ancestors should also receive her spirit seat in peace.”
translations.idiomatic: Now that Empress Xiaojie has been enshrined in the Grand Temple, the Hall of Ancestors should likewise receive her spirit seat.”

sentences.zh: 」乃設神座、儀物於第九室，遣官祭告如儀。

translations.literal: ” A spirit throne and ritual objects were then set up in the ninth chamber, and an official was dispatched to announce the sacrifice according to the rite.
translations.idiomatic: A spirit throne and ritual objects were set up in the ninth chamber, and an official was dispatched to announce the sacrifice according to the rite.

sentences.zh: 萬曆三年，帝欲以孝烈、孝恪二後神位奉安於奉先殿。

translations.literal: In the third year of Wanli, the emperor wished to install the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaolie and Xiaoke in peace at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year of Wanli, the emperor wished to install the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaolie and Xiaoke in the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 禮官謂世宗時，議祔陵祭，不議祔內殿。

translations.literal: The ritual officials said that in the time of Shizong only enshrinement at the mausoleum temple had been debated, not enshrinement in the inner hall.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials said that in the Shizong reign only enshrinement at the mausoleum temple had been discussed, not enshrinement in the inner hall.

sentences.zh: 帝曰：「奉先殿見有孝肅、孝穆、孝惠三後神位，俱皇祖所定，宜遵行祔安。

translations.literal: The emperor said: “The Hall of Ancestors already has the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaosu, Xiaomu, and Xiaohui—all fixed by our imperial grandfather—and enshrinement and installation should be carried out accordingly.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor said: “The Hall of Ancestors already holds the spirit tablets of Empresses Xiaosu, Xiaomu, and Xiaohui, all as fixed by our imperial grandfather; the enshrinement and installation should follow that precedent.

sentences.zh: 」蓋當時三後既各祔陵廟，仍並祭於奉先殿，而外廷莫知也。

translations.literal: ” For at that time, although the three empresses had each been enshrined at the mausoleum temple, they were still jointly sacrificed to at the Hall of Ancestors, a fact unknown outside the court.
translations.idiomatic: In fact, although the three empresses had each been enshrined at the mausoleum temple, they continued to receive joint sacrifice at the Hall of Ancestors—a practice unknown outside the inner court.

sentences.zh: 命輔臣張居正等入視。

translations.literal: He ordered the chief ministers Zhang Juzheng and others to enter and inspect.
translations.idiomatic: He ordered the chief ministers Zhang Juzheng and others to enter and inspect.

sentences.zh: 居正等言：「奉先殿奉安列聖祖妣，凡推尊爲後者，俱得祔享內殿，比之太廟一帝一後者不同，今亦宜奉安祔享。

translations.literal: Juzheng and others said: “The Hall of Ancestors receives in peace the ancestral emperors and empresses of successive reigns; all who were raised to the rank of empress may be enshrined and enjoy sacrifice in the inner hall—unlike the Grand Temple, where one emperor has one empress—and they too should be installed and enshrined for sacrifice.”
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Juzheng and others said: “The Hall of Ancestors enshrines the ancestral emperors and empresses of successive reigns; all who were elevated to empress may be enshrined and receive sacrifice in the inner hall—unlike the Grand Temple, where one emperor is paired with one empress—and these two should likewise be installed and enshrined.”

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ” The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: 先是，冊封告祭，以太常寺官執事，仍題請遣官。

translations.literal: Previously, for enfeoffment announcements and sacrifices, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices conducted the service, while a memorial still requested dispatch of an official.
translations.idiomatic: Previously, for enfeoffment announcements and sacrifices, officials of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices had conducted the service, yet a memorial still requested that an official be dispatched.

sentences.zh: 到萬曆元年，帝親行禮，而遣官之請廢。

translations.literal: By the first year of Wanli the emperor performed the rite in person, and the request to dispatch an official was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: By the first year of Wanli the emperor performed the rite in person, and the request to dispatch an official was dropped.

sentences.zh: 二年，太常寺以內殿在禁地，用內官供事便。

translations.literal: In the second year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices said that because the inner hall lay in the forbidden precinct, it was convenient to use inner eunuchs for the service.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year, the Court of Imperial Sacrifices argued that because the inner hall stood within the forbidden precinct, it was more convenient for inner eunuchs to perform the service.

sentences.zh: 帝俞其請。

translations.literal: The emperor approved the request.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor approved the request.

sentences.zh: 凡聖節、中元、冬至、歲暮，嘉靖初俱告祭於奉先殿。

translations.literal: For the imperial birthday, Zhongyuan, the winter solstice, and year’s end, at the beginning of Jiajing all announcement sacrifices were performed at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: For the imperial birthday, Zhongyuan, the winter solstice, and year’s end, at the beginning of the Jiajing reign all announcement sacrifices were performed at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 十五年，罷中元祭。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year the Zhongyuan sacrifice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year the Zhongyuan sacrifice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 四十五年，罷歲暮祭。

translations.literal: In the forty-fifth year the year-end sacrifice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fifth year the year-end sacrifice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，罷聖節、冬至祭。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing the imperial-birthday and winter-solstice sacrifices were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing the imperial-birthday and winter-solstice sacrifices were abolished.

sentences.zh: 其方澤、朝日、夕月，出告、回參，嘉靖中行於景神殿。

translations.literal: As for the Square Mound, morning sun, evening moon, departure announcements, and return presentations, under Jiajing they were performed at the Jingshen Hall.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrifices at the Square Mound, to the morning sun and evening moon, and departure announcements and return presentations were performed at the Jingshen Hall during the Jiajing reign.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，仍行於奉先殿。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing they were again performed at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing they were again performed at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 諸帝后忌辰，嘉靖以前行於奉先殿。

translations.literal: Death anniversaries of emperors and empresses before Jiajing were observed at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Death anniversaries of emperors and empresses before Jiajing were observed at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 十八年，改高皇帝、後忌辰於景神殿，文皇帝、後以下於永孝殿。

translations.literal: In the eighteenth year the death anniversaries of Gaozu and his empress were moved to the Jingshen Hall, and those of Wenzong and his empress and below to the Yongxiao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighteenth year the death anniversaries of Gaozu and his empress were transferred to the Jingshen Hall, and those of Wenzong and his empress and the rest to the Yongxiao Hall.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，仍行於奉先殿。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year they were again performed at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year they were again performed at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 凡內殿祭告，自萬曆二年後，親祭則祭品告文執事，皆出內監。

translations.literal: For all inner-hall announcement sacrifices after the second year of Wanli, when the emperor sacrificed in person the offerings, prayer texts, and attendants all came from the inner supervision.
translations.idiomatic: For all inner-hall announcement sacrifices after the second year of Wanli, when the emperor sacrificed in person the offerings, prayer texts, and attendants all came from the inner eunuch establishment.

sentences.zh: 遣官代祭，則皆出太常。

translations.literal: When an official was dispatched to sacrifice in his stead, all came from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: When an official was dispatched to sacrifice in his stead, everything came from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 惟品用脯醢者，即親祭亦皆出太常。

translations.literal: Only when dried meat and pickled offerings were used—even for personal sacrifice—all came from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.
translations.idiomatic: Only when dried meat and pickled offerings were used—even for personal sacrifice—did everything still come from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十四年，禮臣言：「近年皇貴妃冊封，祭告奉先殿，祝文執事出內庭，而祭品取之太常，事體不一。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Wanli, ritual officials said: “In recent years, when an imperial noble consort was enfeoffed, the announcement sacrifice at the Hall of Ancestors had prayer texts and attendants from the inner court, while the offerings came from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices—the arrangements were inconsistent.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Wanli, ritual officials said: “In recent years, when an imperial noble consort was enfeoffed, the announcement sacrifice at the Hall of Ancestors had prayer texts and attendants from the inner court but offerings from the Court of Imperial Sacrifices—the arrangements were inconsistent.

sentences.zh: 夫太常專主祀享，而光祿則主膳羞。

translations.literal: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices specializes in sacrificial offerings, while the Court of Imperial Entertainments specializes in food offerings.
translations.idiomatic: The Court of Imperial Sacrifices has charge of sacrificial offerings, while the Court of Imperial Entertainments has charge of food offerings.

sentences.zh: 內庭祭告，蓋取象於食時上食之義也。

translations.literal: Inner-court announcement sacrifices take their model from the meaning of presenting food at mealtimes.
translations.idiomatic: Inner-court announcement sacrifices are modeled on the idea of presenting food at mealtimes.

sentences.zh: 宜遵舊制，凡祭告內殿，無論親行、遣官，其祭品光祿寺供；

translations.literal: The old system should be followed: for all announcement sacrifices in the inner hall, whether performed in person or by dispatched official, the offerings should be supplied by the Court of Imperial Entertainments;
translations.idiomatic: The old system should be followed: for all announcement sacrifices in the inner hall, whether the emperor goes in person or an official is dispatched, the offerings should be supplied by the Court of Imperial Entertainments;

sentences.zh: 惟告文執事人，親行則辦之內庭，遣官則暫用太常寺。

translations.literal: only the prayer text and attendants—when the emperor goes in person they should be arranged by the inner court; when an official is dispatched the Court of Imperial Sacrifices should be used temporarily.”
translations.idiomatic: only for the prayer text and attendants—when the emperor goes in person the inner court should arrange them; when an official is dispatched the Court of Imperial Sacrifices should be used for the time being.”

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ” The proposal was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The proposal was approved.

sentences.zh: ○奉慈殿

translations.literal: ○ Hall of Maternal Kindness
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Hall of Maternal Kindness

sentences.zh: 孝宗即位，追上母妃孝穆太后紀氏諡，祔葬茂陵。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong took the throne, he posthumously honored his mother, Consort Ji, as Empress Xiaomu and enshrined her at Maoling.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong took the throne, he posthumously honored his mother, Consort Ji, as Empress Xiaomu and had her buried at Maoling.

sentences.zh: 以不得祔廟，遂於奉先殿右別建奉慈殿以祀。

translations.literal: Because she could not be enshrined in the ancestral temple, a separate Hall of Maternal Kindness was built to the right of the Hall of Ancestors for her worship.
translations.idiomatic: Because she could not be enshrined in the ancestral temple, a separate Hall of Maternal Kindness was built to the right of the Hall of Ancestors for her worship.

sentences.zh: 一歲五享，薦新忌祭，俱如太廟奉先殿儀。

translations.literal: Five offerings a year, fresh offerings, and death-anniversary sacrifices all followed the rites of the Grand Temple and the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Five offerings a year, fresh seasonal offerings, and death-anniversary sacrifices all followed the rites of the Grand Temple and the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 弘治十七年，孝肅周太后崩。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year of Hongzhi, Empress Dowager Xiaosu of the Zhou clan died.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year of Hongzhi, Empress Dowager Xiaosu of the Zhou clan died.

sentences.zh: 先是成化時，預定周太后祔葬、祔祭之議，至是召輔臣議祔廟禮。

translations.literal: Earlier, in the Chenghua reign, the question of joint burial and enshrinement for Empress Dowager Zhou had been decided in advance; now the chief ministers were summoned to deliberate the enshrinement rite.
translations.idiomatic: Earlier, during the Chenghua reign, joint burial and enshrinement for Empress Dowager Zhou had been decided in advance; the chief ministers were now summoned to deliberate the enshrinement rite.

sentences.zh: 劉健等言：「議誠有之，顧當年所引唐、宋故事，非漢以前制也。

translations.literal: Liu Jian and others said: “The deliberation indeed exists, but the Tang and Song precedents cited at the time were not the system of Han and earlier.”
translations.idiomatic: Liu Jian and others said: “Such a deliberation did exist, but the Tang and Song precedents cited at the time were not the institutions of Han and earlier.”

sentences.zh: 」帝以事當師古，乃援孝穆太后別祭奉慈殿爲言，而命廷臣議。

translations.literal: The emperor, holding that the matter should follow antiquity, cited the separate sacrifice to Empress Xiaomu at the Hall of Maternal Kindness as his argument and ordered the court ministers to deliberate.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, holding that the matter should follow antiquity, cited the separate sacrifice to Empress Xiaomu at the Hall of Maternal Kindness and ordered the court ministers to deliberate.

sentences.zh: 健退，復疏論其事，以堅帝心。

translations.literal: Jian withdrew and memorialized again on the matter to strengthen the emperor’s resolve.
translations.idiomatic: Jian withdrew and memorialized again on the matter to strengthen the emperor’s resolve.

sentences.zh: 於是英國公張懋、吏部尚書馬文升等言：「宗廟之禮，乃天下公議，非子孫得以私之。

translations.literal: Thereupon Zhang Mao, Duke of Ying, Ma Wensheng, Minister of Personnel, and others said: “The rites of the ancestral temple are a matter of public deliberation for the realm, not something descendants may treat as a private affair.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Duke of Ying Zhang Mao, Minister of Personnel Ma Wensheng, and others said: “The rites of the ancestral temple are a matter of public deliberation for the realm, not something descendants may treat as a private affair.

sentences.zh: 殷、周七廟，父昭子穆，各有配座，一帝一後，禮之正儀。

translations.literal: The seven temples of Yin and Zhou had father-zhao and son-mu pairing, each with its matching seat—one emperor, one empress: the correct ritual form.
translations.idiomatic: The seven temples of Yin and Zhou had father-zhao and son-mu pairing, each with its matching seat—one emperor, one empress: the correct ritual form.

sentences.zh: 《春秋》書『考仲子之宮』，胡安國《傳》云：『孟子入惠公之廟，仲子無祭享之所。

translations.literal: The Spring and Autumn Annals records “the palace of Zhongzi, the younger wife”; Hu Anguo’s commentary says: “When Mencius entered Duke Hui’s temple, Zhongzi had no place for sacrifice.”
translations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn Annals records “the palace of Zhongzi, the younger wife”; Hu Anguo’s commentary says: “When Mencius entered Duke Hui’s temple, Zhongzi had no place for sacrifice.”

sentences.zh: 』以此見魯秉周禮，先王之制猶存，祖廟無二配故也。

translations.literal: ” From this it may be seen that Lu upheld the Zhou rites and the institutions of the former kings still survived; the ancestral temple had no double matching.
translations.idiomatic: From this it may be seen that Lu upheld the Zhou rites and the institutions of the former kings still survived; the ancestral temple had no double matching.

sentences.zh: 伏睹憲宗敕諭，有曰『朕心終不自安』。

translations.literal: We have seen in Emperor Xianzong’s edict the words “my heart could never be at ease.”
translations.idiomatic: We have seen in Emperor Xianzong’s edict the words “my heart could never be at ease.”

sentences.zh: 竊窺先帝至情，以重違慈意，因勉從並配之議。

translations.literal: We perceive in the late emperor’s deepest feeling that, out of reluctance to oppose his mother’s wish, he reluctantly assented to joint matching.
translations.idiomatic: We perceive in the late emperor’s deepest feeling that, out of reluctance to oppose his mother’s wish, he reluctantly assented to joint matching.

sentences.zh: 羣臣欲權以濟事，亦不得已而爲此也。

translations.literal: The ministers wished to use expedients to complete the affair; they too had no choice but to do this.
translations.idiomatic: The ministers wished to use expedients to complete the affair; they too had no choice but to do this.

sentences.zh: 據禮區處，上副先帝在天遺志，端有待於今日。

translations.literal: To settle the matter according to ritual would fulfill the late emperor’s will in Heaven; the proper moment awaits today.
translations.idiomatic: To settle the matter according to ritual would fulfill the late emperor’s will in Heaven; the proper moment awaits today.

sentences.zh: 稽之《周禮》，有祀先妣之文，《疏》雲『姜嫄也』，《詩》所謂『閟宮』是已。

translations.literal: Examining the Zhou li, there is text on sacrificing to the primal mother; the commentary says “Jiang Yuan,” and this is what the Odes call the “closed palace.”
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Zhou li, there is text on sacrificing to the primal mother; the commentary says “Jiang Yuan,” and this is what the Odes call the “closed palace.”

sentences.zh: 唐、宋推尊太后，不配食祖廟者，則別立殿以享之，亦得閟宮之義。

translations.literal: When Tang and Song raised empress dowagers in honor but did not match them in the ancestral temple, they built separate halls for their worship—this too fulfills the meaning of the closed palace.
translations.idiomatic: When Tang and Song raised empress dowagers in honor but did not match them in the ancestral temple, they built separate halls for their worship—this too fulfills the meaning of the closed palace.

sentences.zh: 我朝祖宗迄今已溢九廟，配皆無二。

translations.literal: Our dynastic ancestors down to today have already overflowed the nine temples, and in every matching there has been no second consort.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynastic ancestors down to today have already overflowed the nine temples, and in every matching there has been no second consort.

sentences.zh: 今宜於奉先殿外建一新廟，如《詩》之閟宮，宋之別殿，歲時薦享，仍稱太皇太后，則情義兩盡。

translations.literal: Now a new temple should be built outside the Hall of Ancestors, like the closed palace in the Odes and the separate halls of Song; seasonal offerings should be presented, and she should still be styled Grand Empress Dowager—then affection and ritual propriety would both be fulfilled.”
translations.idiomatic: Now a new temple should be built outside the Hall of Ancestors, like the closed palace in the Odes and the separate halls of Song; seasonal offerings should be presented, and she should still be styled Grand Empress Dowager—then affection and ritual propriety would both be fulfilled.”

sentences.zh: 」議上，復召健等至素幄，袖出《奉先殿圖》，指西一區曰：「此奉慈殿也。

translations.literal: When the deliberation was submitted, Jian and others were again summoned to the plain canopy; the emperor drew out the diagram of the Hall of Ancestors and pointed to the western section, saying: “This is the Hall of Maternal Kindness.”
translations.idiomatic: When the deliberation was submitted, Jian and others were again summoned to the plain canopy; the emperor drew out the diagram of the Hall of Ancestors and pointed to the western section, saying: “This is the Hall of Maternal Kindness.”

sentences.zh: 」又指東一區曰：「此神廚也。

translations.literal: He pointed again to the eastern section, saying: “This is the spirit kitchen.”
translations.idiomatic: He pointed again to the eastern section, saying: “This is the spirit kitchen.”

sentences.zh: 」欲於此地別建廟，奉遷孝穆神主，並祭於此。

translations.literal: He wished to build a separate temple on this site, move the spirit tablet of Xiaomu, and sacrifice to both there.
translations.idiomatic: He wished to build a separate temple on this site, move the spirit tablet of Xiaomu, and sacrifice to both there.

sentences.zh: 健等皆對曰：「最當。

translations.literal: Jian and others all replied: “Most fitting.”
translations.idiomatic: Jian and others all replied: “Most fitting.”

sentences.zh: 」已而欽天監奏，年方有礙，廷議暫奉於奉慈殿正中，徙孝穆居左。

translations.literal: Soon the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the year was inauspicious; after court deliberation Xiaosu was temporarily installed in the center of the Hall of Maternal Kindness, and Xiaomu was moved to the left.
translations.idiomatic: Soon the Directorate of Astronomy reported that the year was inauspicious; after court deliberation Xiaosu was temporarily installed in the center of the Hall of Maternal Kindness, and Xiaomu was moved to the left.

sentences.zh: 及孝宗崩，武宗即位，禮部始進奉安孝肅神主儀。

translations.literal: When Xiaozong died and Wuzong took the throne, the Ministry of Rites first presented the rite for installing the spirit tablet of Xiaosu in peace.
translations.idiomatic: When Xiaozong died and the Wuzong took the throne, the Ministry of Rites first presented the rite for installing the spirit tablet of Xiaosu in peace.

sentences.zh: 前期致齋三日，告奉先殿及孝宗几筵。

translations.literal: Three days beforehand one observed abstinence; the Hall of Ancestors and Xiaozong’s spirit couch were announced to.
translations.idiomatic: Three days beforehand one observed abstinence; announcement was made to the Hall of Ancestors and to Xiaozong’s spirit couch.

sentences.zh: 是日早，帝具黑翼善冠、淺淡色服、黑犀帶，告孝穆神座。

translations.literal: On that day early, the emperor wore the black yishan crown, light-colored garments, and a black rhinoceros belt, and announced to the spirit seat of Xiaomu.
translations.idiomatic: On that day early, the emperor wore the black yishan crown, light-colored garments, and a black rhinoceros belt, and announced to the spirit seat of Xiaomu.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，帝詣神座前，請神主降座。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished, the emperor went before the spirit seat and requested that the spirit tablet descend from its seat.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished, the emperor went before the spirit seat and requested that the spirit tablet descend from its seat.

sentences.zh: 帝捧主立，內執事移神座於殿左間。

translations.literal: The emperor held the tablet standing; inner attendants moved the spirit seat to the left bay of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor held the tablet standing; inner attendants moved the spirit seat to the left bay of the hall.

sentences.zh: 帝奉安訖，行叩頭禮，至午，帝詣清寧宮孝肅几筵，行禮畢，內侍進神主輿於殿前，衣冠輿于丹陛上。

translations.literal: When the emperor had finished installing the tablet in peace, he performed the prostration rite; at noon he went to the spirit couch of Xiaosu in the Qingning Palace, and when the rite was finished inner attendants brought the spirit-tablet palanquin before the hall and the vestment palanquin to the red steps.
translations.idiomatic: When the emperor had finished installing the tablet, he performed the prostration rite; at noon he went to Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu’s spirit couch in the Qingning Palace, and when the rite was finished inner attendants brought the spirit-tablet palanquin before the hall and the vestment palanquin to the red steps.

sentences.zh: 帝詣拜位，親王吉服後隨，四拜，興。

translations.literal: The emperor went to the bowing position; princes in ceremonial dress followed behind; four bows, then rising.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor took his place at the bowing position, with princes in ceremonial dress following behind; he bowed four times and rose.

sentences.zh: 帝捧神主由殿中門出，奉安輿內。

translations.literal: The emperor bore the spirit tablet out through the central gate of the hall and installed it in peace within the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor bore the spirit tablet out through the central gate of the hall and placed it in the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 執事捧衣冠置輿後隨。

translations.literal: Attendants bore the vestments and placed them in the palanquin, following behind.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants bore the vestments and placed them in the palanquin behind.

sentences.zh: 帝率親王步從。

translations.literal: The emperor led the princes, walking in attendance.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor led the princes on foot in attendance.

sentences.zh: 至寶善門外，太皇太后、皇太后率宮妃迎於門內。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Baoshan Gate, the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager led the palace consorts to welcome them inside the gate.
translations.idiomatic: Outside the Baoshan Gate, the Grand Empress Dowager and Empress Dowager led the palace consorts to welcome them inside the gate.

sentences.zh: 先詣奉慈殿，序立於殿西。

translations.literal: They first went to the Hall of Maternal Kindness and stood in order on the west side of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: They first went to the Hall of Maternal Kindness and took their places in order on the west side of the hall.

sentences.zh: 神主輿至奉先殿門外，少駐。

translations.literal: When the spirit-tablet palanquin reached the outside of the Hall of Ancestors gate, it halted briefly.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit-tablet palanquin reached the gate of the Hall of Ancestors, it halted briefly.

sentences.zh: 帝詣輿前跪，請神主詣奉先殿，俯伏，興，捧神主由殿左門入，至殿內褥位，跪，置神主。

translations.literal: The emperor went before the palanquin and knelt, requesting the spirit tablet to proceed to the Hall of Ancestors; he prostrated himself, rose, bore the spirit tablet in through the left gate of the hall to the cushioned place within the hall, knelt, and set down the spirit tablet.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went before the palanquin and knelt, asking the spirit tablet to proceed to the Hall of Ancestors; he prostrated himself, rose, bore the spirit tablet in through the left gate to the cushioned place within the hall, knelt, and set down the tablet.

sentences.zh: 帝行五拜三叩頭禮畢，捧神主，仍由左門出，安輿內。

translations.literal: When the emperor had finished five bows and three prostrations, he bore the spirit tablet and again went out through the left gate, installing it within the palanquin.
translations.idiomatic: After five bows and three prostrations, he bore the spirit tablet out again through the left gate and placed it in the palanquin.

sentences.zh: 至奉慈殿門外，帝捧神主由中門入，奉安於神座訖，行安神禮，三獻如常儀。

translations.literal: At the outside of the Hall of Maternal Kindness gate, the emperor bore the spirit tablet in through the central gate, installed it in peace on the spirit throne, performed the rite of pacifying the spirit, and made three offerings according to the usual rite.
translations.idiomatic: At the gate of the Hall of Maternal Kindness, the emperor bore the spirit tablet in through the central gate, installed it on the spirit throne, performed the rite of pacifying the spirit, and made three offerings according to the usual rite.

sentences.zh: 太皇太后以下四拜。

translations.literal: The Grand Empress Dowager and those below her bowed four times.
translations.idiomatic: The Grand Empress Dowager and those of lower rank bowed four times.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，內侍官設褥位於殿正中之南。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished, inner attendant officials set a cushioned place south of the center of the hall.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished, inner attendant officials set a cushioned place south of the center of the hall.

sentences.zh: 帝詣孝穆皇太后神座前，跪請神主謁孝肅太皇太后，跪置於褥位上，俯伏，興，行五拜三叩頭禮。

translations.literal: The emperor went before the spirit throne of Grand Empress Dowager Xiaomu, knelt and requested the spirit tablet to visit Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu, knelt and placed it on the cushioned place, prostrated himself, rose, and performed five bows and three prostrations.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor went before Grand Empress Dowager Xiaomu’s spirit throne, knelt and asked the spirit tablet to visit Grand Empress Dowager Xiaosu, knelt and placed it on the cushioned place, prostrated himself, rose, and performed five bows and three prostrations.

sentences.zh: 畢，帝捧主興，仍安於神座訖，行安神禮如前，皇太后以下四拜。

translations.literal: When finished, the emperor bore the tablet and rose, again installed it in peace on the spirit throne, performed the rite of pacifying the spirit as before, and the Empress Dowager and those below bowed four times.
translations.idiomatic: When this was finished, the emperor bore the tablet and rose, again installed it on the spirit throne, performed the rite of pacifying the spirit as before, and the Empress Dowager and those below bowed four times.

sentences.zh: 十五年，帝以三太后別祀奉慈殿，不若奉於陵殿爲宜，廷臣議：「古天子宗廟，惟一帝一後，所生母，薦於寢，身歿而已。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, the emperor held that separate sacrifice to the three empress dowagers at the Hall of Maternal Kindness was inferior to enshrining them at the mausoleum hall; the court ministers deliberated: “In antiquity the Son of Heaven’s ancestral temple had only one emperor and one empress; a birth mother was offered sacrifice in the private apartments, and that ended with her death.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, the emperor held that having the three empress dowagers worshipped separately at the Hall of Maternal Kindness was inferior to enshrining them at the mausoleum hall; the court ministers deliberated: “In antiquity the Son of Heaven’s ancestral temple had only one emperor and one empress; a birth mother received offerings in the private apartments, and that ended with her death.

sentences.zh: 孝宗奉慈殿之祭，蓋子祀生母，以盡終身之孝焉耳。

translations.literal: Xiaozong’s sacrifice at the Hall of Maternal Kindness was simply a son sacrificing to his birth mother, to fulfill lifelong filial piety.
translations.idiomatic: Xiaozong’s sacrifice at the Hall of Maternal Kindness was simply a son sacrificing to his birth mother, to fulfill a lifetime of filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 然《禮》『妾母不世祭』，《疏》曰：『不世祭者，謂子祭之，於孫則止。

translations.literal: Yet the Rites say, “A mother who was a concubine is not sacrificed to in perpetuity”; the commentary says, “Not sacrificed to in perpetuity means the son sacrifices; with the grandson it stops.
translations.idiomatic: Yet the Rites say, “A mother who was a concubine is not sacrificed to in perpetuity”; the commentary says, “Not sacrificed to in perpetuity means the son sacrifices; with the grandson it stops.

sentences.zh: 』明繼祖重，故不復顧其私祖母也。

translations.literal: ” Ming stresses succession to the ancestral line, and therefore does not again attend to one’s private grandmother.
translations.idiomatic: ” Ming stresses succession to the ancestral line, and therefore does not again attend to one’s private grandmother.

sentences.zh: 今陛下於孝肅，曾孫也；

translations.literal: Now Your Majesty toward Xiaosu is a great-grandson;
translations.idiomatic: Your Majesty’s relation to Xiaosu is that of great-grandson;

sentences.zh: 孝穆，孫屬也；

translations.literal: toward Xiaomu, grandson by line;
translations.idiomatic: to Xiaomu, grandson by line;

sentences.zh: 孝惠，孫也。

translations.literal: toward Xiaohui, grandson.
translations.idiomatic: to Xiaohui, grandson.

sentences.zh: 禮不世祭，議當祧。

translations.literal: The rites do not sacrifice in perpetuity; deliberation should remove them from the line.
translations.idiomatic: The rites do not provide for perpetual sacrifice; they should be removed from the line.

sentences.zh: 考宋熙寧罷奉慈廟故事，與今同。

translations.literal: Examining the Song story of abolishing the Hall of Maternal Kindness in the Xining reign, it is the same as today.
translations.idiomatic: Examining the Song precedent of abolishing the Hall of Maternal Kindness in the Xining reign, the case is the same as today.

sentences.zh: 宜遷主陵廟，歲時祔享如故。

translations.literal: The tablets should be moved to the mausoleum temple, and seasonal joint offerings should continue as before.
translations.idiomatic: The tablets should be moved to the mausoleum temple, and seasonal joint offerings should continue as before.

sentences.zh: 」報可。

translations.literal: ” Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was given.

sentences.zh: 奉慈殿遂罷。

translations.literal: The Hall of Maternal Kindness was then abolished.
translations.idiomatic: The Hall of Maternal Kindness was then abolished.

sentences.zh: 世宗孝烈後，隆慶時祀弘孝殿，萬曆三年遷祔奉先殿。

translations.literal: Shizong’s Empress Xiaolie, during Longqing was sacrificed to at the Hall of Extended Filial Piety; in the third year of Wanli she was moved and enshrined at the Hall of Ancestors.
translations.idiomatic: Shizong’s Empress Xiaolie was sacrificed to at the Hall of Extended Filial Piety during Longqing; in the third year of Wanli she was moved and enshrined at the Hall of Ancestors.

sentences.zh: 穆宗母孝恪皇太后，隆慶初祀神霄殿，又祔孝懿後於其側。

translations.literal: Muzong’s mother, Grand Empress Dowager Xiaoke, at the beginning of Longqing was sacrificed to at the Hall of Divine Empyrean, and Empress Xiaoyi was also enshrined at her side.
translations.idiomatic: Muzong’s mother, Grand Empress Dowager Xiaoke, was at first sacrificed to at the Hall of Divine Empyrean in Longqing, and Empress Xiaoyi was also enshrined at her side.

sentences.zh: 六年，孝懿祔太廟，萬曆三年，孝恪遷祔奉先殿，二殿俱罷。

translations.literal: In the sixth year Xiaoyi was enshrined in the Grand Temple; in the third year of Wanli Xiaoke was moved and enshrined at the Hall of Ancestors, and both halls were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year Xiaoyi was enshrined in the Grand Temple; in the third year of Wanli Xiaoke was moved and enshrined at the Hall of Ancestors, and both halls were abolished.

sentences.zh: ○獻皇帝廟

translations.literal: ○ Temple of the Offering Emperor
translations.idiomatic: ○ The Temple of the Offering Emperor

sentences.zh: 嘉靖二年四月，始命興獻帝家廟亭祀，樂用八佾。

translations.literal: In the fourth month of the second year of Jiajing, orders were first given for pavilion sacrifice at the family temple of the Offering Emperor Xing, with music using eight rows of dancers.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of the second year of Jiajing, orders were first given for pavilion sacrifice at the family temple of the Offering Emperor Xing, with music using eight rows of dancers.

sentences.zh: 初，禮官議廟制未決，監生何淵上書，請立世室於太廟東。

translations.literal: At first, when ritual officials had not settled the temple system, the student He Yuan memorialized requesting establishment of an Eternal Chamber east of the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: At first, while ritual officials had not settled the temple system, the student He Yuan memorialized requesting establishment of an Eternal Chamber east of the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 禮部尚書汪俊等皆謂不可。

translations.literal: Minister of Rites Wang Jun and others all said it could not be done.
translations.idiomatic: Minister of Rites Wang Jun and others all said it could not be done.

sentences.zh: 帝諭奉先殿側別立一室，以盡孝思。

translations.literal: The emperor instructed that a separate chamber be built beside the Hall of Ancestors to fulfill filial devotion.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor instructed that a separate chamber be built beside the Hall of Ancestors to fulfill filial devotion.

sentences.zh: 禮官集議言：「奉慈之建，禮臣據姜嫄特廟而言。

translations.literal: The ritual officials assembled and deliberated, saying: “The building of the Hall of Maternal Kindness—ritual ministers spoke on the basis of Jiang Yuan’s special temple.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials assembled and deliberated, saying: “The building of the Hall of Maternal Kindness—ritual ministers spoke on the basis of Jiang Yuan’s special temple.

sentences.zh: 至爲本生父立廟大內，古所未有，惟漢哀爲定陶共王建廟京師，不可爲法。

translations.literal: As for building a temple within the inner palace for one’s birth father, there has never been such a thing in antiquity; only Han Aidi built a temple in the capital for Prince Gong of Dingtao—this cannot serve as a model.
translations.idiomatic: As for building a temple within the inner palace for one’s birth father, there has never been such a thing in antiquity; only Han Aidi built a temple in the capital for Prince Gong of Dingtao—this cannot serve as a model.

sentences.zh: 」詹事石珤等亦言不可。

sentences.zh: 不聽。

translations.literal: He did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: He did not listen.

sentences.zh: 葺奉慈殿後爲觀德殿以奉之。

translations.idiomatic: The rear of the Hall of Maternal Kindness was repaired as the Hall of Observing Virtue to receive his worship.

sentences.zh: 四年四月，淵已授光祿寺署丞，覆上書請立世室，崇祀皇考於太廟，禮部尚書席書等議：「天子七廟，周文、武並有功德，故立文、武世室於三昭穆之上。

sentences.zh: 獻皇帝追稱帝號，未爲天子。

translations.literal: The Offering Emperor was posthumously given an imperial title but was never Son of Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: The Offering Emperor was posthumously given an imperial title but was never Son of Heaven.

sentences.zh: 淵妄爲諛詞，乞寢其奏。

translations.literal: Yuan presumptuously made flattering words; we beg that his memorial be laid aside.
translations.idiomatic: Yuan presumptuously made flattering words; we beg that his memorial be laid aside.

translations.idiomatic: ” The emperor ordered further deliberation; Shu and others said: “If the tablet is placed above Wuzong.

translations.literal: then Wuzong was sovereign, and the division cannot be usurped.
translations.idiomatic: Then Wuzong was sovereign, and the rank could not be usurped.

translations.idiomatic: If placed below Wuzong, then the Offering Emperor was his uncle, and the spirit would never be at peace.

sentences.zh: 」時廷臣於稱考稱伯，異同相半，至議祔廟，無一人以爲可者。

translations.literal: ” At that time among court ministers on calling him Father or calling him Uncle, opinions were half and half; but when it came to enshrinement in the temple, not one person thought it permissible.
translations.idiomatic: ” At that time among court ministers on calling him Father or calling him Uncle, opinions were evenly divided; but when it came to enshrinement in the temple, not one person thought it permissible.

sentences.zh: 學士張璁、桂萼亦皆以爲不可，書復密疏爭之。

translations.literal: Academicians Zhang Cong and Gui E also all thought it could not be done; Shu again sent a secret memorial arguing against it.
translations.idiomatic: Academicians Zhang Cong and Gui E also all thought it could not be done; Shu again sent a secret memorial arguing against it.

sentences.zh: 帝不聽，復令會議。

translations.literal: The emperor did not listen and again ordered joint deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor did not listen and again ordered joint deliberation.

sentences.zh: 乃準漢宣故事，於皇城內立一禰廟，如文華殿制。

translations.literal: They then followed the story of Han Xuan, establishing a temple to the father within the imperial city, on the model of the Wenhua Hall.
translations.idiomatic: They then followed the story of Han Xuan, establishing a temple to the father within the imperial city, on the model of the Wenhua Hall.

sentences.zh: 籩豆樂舞，一用天子禮。

translations.literal: Sacrificial vessels, music, and dance all used Son of Heaven rites.
translations.idiomatic: Sacrificial vessels, music, and dance all used Son of Heaven rites.

sentences.zh: 帝親定其名曰世廟。

translations.literal: The emperor personally fixed its name as the Eternal Temple.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor personally fixed its name as the Eternal Temple.

sentences.zh: 五年七月，諭工部以觀德殿窄隘，欲別建於奉天殿左。

translations.literal: In the seventh month of the fifth year he instructed the Ministry of Works that the Hall of Observing Virtue was cramped and he wished to build separately to the left of the Hall of Supreme Heaven.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventh month of the fifth year he instructed the Ministry of Works that the Hall of Observing Virtue was cramped and he wished to build separately to the left of the Hall of Supreme Heaven.

sentences.zh: 尚書趙璜謂不可，不聽。

translations.literal: Minister Zhao Huang said it could not be done; he did not listen.
translations.idiomatic: Minister Zhao Huang said it could not be done; he did not listen.

sentences.zh: 乃建於奉先之東，曰崇先殿。

translations.literal: It was then built to the east of the Hall of Ancestors and called the Hall of Honoring the Ancestor.
translations.idiomatic: It was then built to the east of the Hall of Ancestors and called the Hall of Honoring the Ancestor.

sentences.zh: 十三年，命易承天家廟曰隆慶殿。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year orders were given to change the Chengtian family temple to the Longqing Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year orders were given to change the Chengtian family temple to the Longqing Hall.

sentences.zh: 十五年，以避渠道，遷世廟，更號曰獻皇帝廟，遂改舊世廟曰景神殿，寢殿曰永孝殿。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year, to avoid a canal, the Eternal Temple was moved and renamed the Temple of the Offering Emperor; the old Eternal Temple was then changed to the Jingshen Hall, and the sleeping hall to the Yongxiao Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year, to avoid a canal, the Eternal Temple was moved and renamed the Temple of the Offering Emperor; the old Eternal Temple was then changed to the Jingshen Hall, and the sleeping hall to the Yongxiao Hall.

sentences.zh: 十七年，以豐坊請，稱宗以配明堂。

translations.literal: In the seventeenth year, at Feng Fang’s request, he was styled Ancestor to match at the Bright Hall.
translations.idiomatic: In the seventeenth year, at Feng Fang’s request, he was styled Ancestor to match at the Bright Hall.

sentences.zh: 禮官不敢違，集議者久之，言：「古者父子異昭穆，兄弟同世數。

translations.literal: The ritual officials dared not disobey; after long joint deliberation they said: “In antiquity father and son had different zhao and mu, while brothers shared the same generation count.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual officials dared not disobey; after long joint deliberation they said: “In antiquity father and son had different zhao and mu, while brothers shared the same generation count.

sentences.zh: 故殷有四君一世而同廟，宋太祖、太宗同居昭位。

translations.literal: Therefore Yin had four rulers of one generation sharing one temple; Song Taizu and Taizong dwelt together in the zhao position.
translations.idiomatic: Therefore Yin had four rulers of one generation sharing one temple; Song Taizu and Taizong dwelt together in the zhao position.

sentences.zh: 今皇考與孝宗當同一廟。

translations.literal: Now the imperial father and Xiaozong should share one temple.
translations.idiomatic: Now the imperial father and Xiaozong should share one temple.

sentences.zh: 」遂奉獻皇帝祔太廟。

translations.literal: ” The Offering Emperor was then enshrined in the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: ” The Offering Emperor was then enshrined in the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 二十二年，更新太廟，廷議睿宗、孝宗並居一廟，同爲昭。

translations.literal: In the twenty-second year the Grand Temple was renewed; court deliberation held that Ruizong and Xiaozong should both dwell in one temple, together as zhao.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-second year the Grand Temple was renewed; court deliberation held that Ruizong and Xiaozong should both dwell in one temple, together as zhao.

sentences.zh: 帝責諸臣不竭忠任事，寢其議。

translations.literal: The emperor reproached the ministers for not serving loyally to the utmost and shelved the deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor reproached the ministers for not serving loyally to the utmost and shelved the deliberation.

sentences.zh: 已而左庶子江汝璧請遷皇考廟於穆廟首，以當將來世室，與成祖廟並峙。

translations.literal: Soon thereafter Left Sublector Jiang Rubi requested moving the imperial father’s temple to the head of the mu temples, to serve as the future Eternal Chamber, standing alongside Chengzu’s temple.
translations.idiomatic: Soon thereafter Left Sublector Jiang Rubi requested moving the imperial father’s temple to the head of the mu temples, to serve as the future Eternal Chamber, standing alongside Chengzu’s temple.

translations.literal: Right Supporter Guo Xiyan also wished outside Taizu’s temple and Wen’s Eternal Chamber to establish only four parental temples, and remove Xiaozong and Wuzong from the line.
translations.idiomatic: Right Supporter Guo Xiyan also wished, outside Taizu’s temple and Wen’s Eternal Chamber, to establish only four parental temples and remove Xiaozong and Wuzong from the line.

sentences.zh: 以禮臣斥其妄而止。

translations.literal: The ritual ministers denounced his presumption and it was stopped.
translations.idiomatic: The ritual ministers denounced his presumption and it was stopped.

sentences.zh: 二十四年六月，新太廟成，遂奉睿宗於太廟之左第四，序躋武宗上，而罷特廟之祀。

translations.literal: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year the new Grand Temple was completed; Ruizong was then received in the fourth place to the left of the Grand Temple, advanced in order above Wuzong, and special-temple sacrifice was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth month of the twenty-fourth year the new Grand Temple was completed; Ruizong was then received in the fourth place to the left of the Grand Temple, advanced in order above Wuzong, and special-temple sacrifice was abolished.

sentences.zh: 四十四年，以舊廟柱產芝，更號曰玉芝宮，定日供時享儀。

translations.literal: In the forty-fourth year, because spirit mushrooms grew on the old temple pillars, it was renamed the Palace of Jade Fungus, and the rite of daily offerings at set times was fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the forty-fourth year, because spirit mushrooms grew on the old temple pillars, it was renamed the Palace of Jade Fungus, and the rite of daily offerings at set times was fixed.

sentences.zh: 穆宗初，因禮臣請，乃罷時享及節序、忌辰、有事奉告之祭，但進日供而已。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Muzong’s reign, at the ritual ministers’ request, timed offerings and sacrifices at seasonal festivals, death anniversaries, and announcement sacrifices on special occasions were abolished; only daily offerings were presented.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Muzong’s reign, at the ritual ministers’ request, timed offerings and sacrifices at seasonal festivals, death anniversaries, and announcement sacrifices on special occasions were abolished; only daily offerings were presented.

sentences.zh: 隆慶元年，禮科王治請罷獻皇祔廟，而專祀之世廟，章下所司。

translations.literal: In the first year of Longqing, Wang Zhi of the Ritual Section requested abolishing the Offering Emperor’s enshrinement in the temple and sacrificing to him exclusively in the Eternal Temple; the memorial was sent down to the responsible offices.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Longqing, Wang Zhi of the Ritual Section requested abolishing the Offering Emperor’s enshrinement in the temple and sacrificing to him exclusively in the Eternal Temple; the memorial was sent down to the responsible offices.

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Wanli, Ding Ruqian of the Ritual Section requested continuing exclusive sacrifice at the Palace of Jade Fungus and restoring Xuanzong’s imperial crown and vestments in the Grand Temple.

translations.idiomatic: The emperor reproached Ruqian for presumptuous deliberation and demoted him to an outside post.

translations.idiomatic: When Guangzong is advanced and enshrined, either follow the old removal or follow a new deliberation.

translations.idiomatic: For while the filial son certainly serves his parent with affection, the humane man should lead his ancestors with righteousness.

translations.idiomatic: ○ Princes’ joint offerings

translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the new Grand Temple was completed; sacrifice was added for Consort Tian of Mengcheng and Consort Tang of Xuyi.

translations.literal: In the Zhengde reign, Censor Xu Wenhua said: “In a clan, when an adult dies without posterity, sacrifice ends with the grandson of the deceased’s brother.
translations.idiomatic: In the Zhengde reign, Censor Xu Wenhua said: “In a clan, when an adult dies without posterity, sacrifice ends with the grandson of the deceased’s brother.

translations.idiomatic: The princes have now reached five or six generations; they should be removed from the line.

translations.idiomatic: During the Jiajing reign they were still arrayed in the east wing.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，新建太廟成，復進列東壁，罷分獻。

translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year, when the new Grand Temple was completed, they were again advanced and arrayed on the east wall, and divided offerings were abolished.

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Wanli, Director of the Court of Imperial Sacrifices Pei Yingzhang said: “The princes were originally enshrined as joint offerings of the great-grandfather.

translations.literal: Now the temples of the four ancestors have been removed from the line, while the princes have nowhere to be enshrined; offerings should be abolished and they should be enshrined in the removed-temple store.
translations.idiomatic: Now the temples of the four ancestors have been removed from the line, while the princes have nowhere to be enshrined; offerings should be abolished and they should be enshrined in the removed-temple store.

sentences.zh: 」禮部言：「祧以藏毀廟之主，爲祖非爲孫。

translations.literal: ” The Ministry of Rites said: “The removed-temple store holds tablets of destroyed temples; it is for ancestors, not for grandsons.
translations.idiomatic: ” The Ministry of Rites said: “The removed-temple store holds tablets of destroyed temples; it is for ancestors, not for grandsons.

translations.idiomatic: The rites provide for removal from the line; one does not hear of matching to the removed-temple store.

translations.literal: We request continuing to follow the initial system and arraying them in the east wing as the recent rite.
translations.idiomatic: We request continuing to follow the initial system and arraying them in the east wing as the recent rite.

translations.literal: ” Approval was given.

translations.literal: ○ Meritorious ministers’ matching offerings
translations.idiomatic: ○ Meritorious ministers’ matching offerings
