translations.literal: In the second year of Hongwu, at the Grand Temple offering, Liao Yong’an, Yu Tonghai, Zhang Desheng, Sang Shijie, Geng Zaicheng, Hu Dahai, and Zhao Desheng were matched.
translations.idiomatic: In the second year of Hongwu, at the Grand Temple offering, Liao Yong’an, Yu Tonghai, Zhang Desheng, Sang Shijie, Geng Zaicheng, Hu Dahai, and Zhao Desheng were matched.

sentences.zh: 設青布幃六於太廟庭中，遣官分獻。

translations.literal: Six green-cloth curtains were set up in the Grand Temple courtyard, and officials were dispatched for divided offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Six green-cloth curtains were set up in the Grand Temple courtyard, and officials were dispatched for divided offerings.

sentences.zh: 俟皇帝亞獻將畢，行禮。

translations.literal: They waited until the emperor’s secondary offering was nearly finished, then performed the rite.
translations.idiomatic: They waited until the emperor’s secondary offering was nearly finished, then performed the rite.

sentences.zh: 每歲春秋享廟，則配食於仁祖廟之東廡。

translations.literal: Each year at the spring and autumn temple offerings, they received matching sacrifice at the east wing of Renzu’s temple.
translations.idiomatic: Each year at the spring and autumn temple offerings, they received matching sacrifice at the east wing of Renzu’s temple.

sentences.zh: 三年，定配享功臣常遇春以下凡八位。

translations.literal: In the third year, eight meritorious ministers from Chang Yuchun downward were fixed for matching sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the third year, eight meritorious ministers from Chang Yuchun downward were fixed for matching sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 春夏於仁祖廟西廡，秋冬於德祖廟西廡，設位東向，遂罷幃次之設。

translations.literal: In spring and summer at the west wing of Renzu’s temple, in autumn and winter at the west wing of Dezu’s temple, seats were set facing east, and the curtain pavilions were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In spring and summer at the west wing of Renzu’s temple, in autumn and winter at the west wing of Dezu’s temple, seats were set facing east, and the curtain pavilions were abolished.

sentences.zh: 更定三獻禮，皇帝初獻，時獻官即分詣行禮，不拜。

translations.literal: The three-offering rite was revised: the emperor made the initial offering, and the seasonal offering officials at once went to perform the rite separately, without bowing.
translations.idiomatic: The three-offering rite was revised: the emperor made the initial offering, and the seasonal offering officials at once went to perform the rite separately, without bowing.

sentences.zh: 四年，太祖謂中書省臣：「太廟之祭，以功臣配列廡間。

translations.literal: In the fourth year, the Taizu said to members of the Secretariat: “The Grand Temple sacrifice arrays meritorious ministers between the wings.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year, the Taizu said to members of the Secretariat: “The Grand Temple sacrifice arrays meritorious ministers between the wings.

sentences.zh: 今既定太廟合祭禮，朕以祖宗具在，使功臣故舊歿者得少依神靈，以同享祀，不獨朝廷宗廟盛典，亦以寓朕不忘功臣之心。

translations.literal: Now that the Grand Temple joint-sacrifice rite has been fixed, I, with the ancestors all present, allow deceased meritorious ministers and old companions to rely a little on the spirits and share in the sacrifice—not only a grand ceremony of the court ancestral temple, but also to embody my heart that does not forget the meritorious ministers.
translations.idiomatic: Now that the Grand Temple joint-sacrifice rite has been fixed, I, with the ancestors all present, allow deceased meritorious ministers and old companions to rely a little on the spirits and share in the sacrifice—not only a grand ceremony of the court ancestral temple, but also to embody my resolve never to forget the meritorious ministers.

sentences.zh: 」於是禮官議：「凡合祭時，爲黃布幄殿，中祖考神位，旁設兩壁，以享親王及功臣，令大臣分獻。

translations.literal: ” Thereupon the ritual officials deliberated: “Whenever joint sacrifice is performed, a yellow-cloth curtain hall is made, with the ancestral spirit seats in the center and two side walls set up to receive princes and meritorious ministers, ordering great ministers to make divided offerings.
translations.idiomatic: ” Thereupon the ritual officials deliberated: “Whenever joint sacrifice is performed, a yellow-cloth curtain hall is made, with the ancestral spirit seats in the center and two side walls set up to receive princes and meritorious ministers, ordering great ministers to make divided offerings.

sentences.zh: 」制可。

translations.literal: ” The regulation was approved.
translations.idiomatic: The regulation was approved.

sentences.zh: 已而命去布幄。

translations.literal: Soon orders were given to remove the cloth curtains.
translations.idiomatic: Soon orders were given to remove the cloth curtains.

sentences.zh: 九年，新太廟成，以徐達、常遇春、李文忠、鄧愈、湯和、沐英、俞通海、張德勝、胡大海、趙得勝、耿再成、桑世傑十二位配於西廡，罷廖永安。

translations.literal: In the ninth year the new Grand Temple was completed; twelve persons—Xu Da, Chang Yuchun, Li Wenzhong, Deng Yu, Tang He, Mu Ying, Yu Tonghai, Zhang Desheng, Hu Dahai, Zhao Desheng, Geng Zaicheng, and Sang Shijie—were matched at the west wing, and Liao Yong’an was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year the new Grand Temple was completed; twelve persons—Xu Da, Chang Yuchun, Li Wenzhong, Deng Yu, Tang He, Mu Ying, Yu Tonghai, Zhang Desheng, Hu Dahai, Zhao Desheng, Geng Zaicheng, and Sang Shijie—were matched at the west wing, and Liao Yong’an was abolished.

sentences.zh: 建文時，禮部侍郎宋禮言：「功臣自有雞籠山廟，請罷太廟配享。

translations.literal: In the Jianwen reign, Vice Minister of Rites Song Li said: “The meritorious ministers already have the Jilongshan temple; we request abolishing matching sacrifice at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the Jianwen reign, Vice Minister of Rites Song Li said: “The meritorious ministers already have the Jilongshan temple; we request abolishing matching sacrifice at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 」帝以先帝所定，不從。

translations.literal: ” The emperor, because it had been fixed by the late emperor, did not follow.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor, because it had been fixed by the late emperor, did not follow.

sentences.zh: 且令候太廟享畢，別遣官即其廟祭之。

translations.literal: Moreover he ordered that after the Grand Temple offering was finished, separate officials be dispatched to sacrifice at their temple.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover he ordered that after the Grand Temple offering was finished, separate officials be dispatched to sacrifice at their temple.

sentences.zh: 洪熙元年，以張玉、硃能、姚廣孝配享太廟。

translations.literal: In the first year of Hongxi, Zhang Yu, Zhu Neng, and Yao Guangxiao were matched at the Grand Temple.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Hongxi, Zhang Yu, Zhu Neng, and Yao Guangxiao were matched at the Grand Temple.

sentences.zh: 遣張輔、硃勇、王通及尚寶少卿姚繼各祭其父。

translations.literal: Zhang Fu, Zhu Yong, Wang Tong, and Vice Director of the Imperial Treasures Yao Ji were dispatched each to sacrifice to his father.
translations.idiomatic: Zhang Fu, Zhu Yong, Wang Tong, and Vice Director of the Imperial Treasures Yao Ji were dispatched each to sacrifice to his father.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖九年，以廖道南言，罷姚廣孝。

translations.literal: In the ninth year of Jiajing, at Liao Daonan’s word, Yao Guangxiao was abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the ninth year of Jiajing, at Liao Daonan’s word, Yao Guangxiao was abolished.

sentences.zh: 十年，以刑部郎中李瑜議，進劉基，位次六王。

translations.literal: In the tenth year, at Section Director Li Yu’s deliberation, Liu Ji was advanced, his place below the six princes.
translations.idiomatic: In the tenth year, at Section Director Li Yu’s deliberation, Liu Ji was advanced, his place below the six princes.

sentences.zh: 十六年，以武定侯郭勳奏，進其祖英。

translations.literal: In the sixteenth year, at Marquis of Wuding Guo Xun’s memorial, his grandfather Ying was advanced.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixteenth year, at Marquis of Wuding Guo Xun’s memorial, his grandfather Ying was advanced.

sentences.zh: 初，二廟功臣，位各以爵，及進基位公侯上，至是復令禮官議合二廟功臣敘爵。

translations.literal: At first, meritorious ministers of the two temples were each placed by rank; when Ji was advanced above dukes and marquises, ritual officials were again ordered to deliberate ranking the meritorious ministers of the two temples by title.
translations.idiomatic: At first, meritorious ministers of the two temples were each placed by rank; when Ji was advanced above dukes and marquises, ritual officials were again ordered to deliberate ranking the meritorious ministers of the two temples by title.

sentences.zh: 於是列英於桑世傑上，張玉、硃能於沐英下，基於世傑下。

translations.literal: Thereupon Ying was placed above Sang Shijie, Zhang Yu and Zhu Neng below Mu Ying, and Ji below Shijie.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon Ying was placed above Sang Shijie, Zhang Yu and Zhu Neng below Mu Ying, and Ji below Shijie.

sentences.zh: 二十四年，進諸配位於新太廟西壁，罷分獻。

translations.literal: In the twenty-fourth year all matching places were advanced to the west wall of the new Grand Temple, and divided offerings were abolished.
translations.idiomatic: In the twenty-fourth year all matching places were advanced to the west wall of the new Grand Temple, and divided offerings were abolished.

sentences.zh: 萬曆十四年，太常卿裴應章言：「廟中列後在上，異姓之臣禮當別嫌。

translations.literal: In the fourteenth year of Wanli, Director Pei Yingzhang said: “In the temple the empresses are arrayed above; for ministers of another surname the rites should avoid suspicion.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourteenth year of Wanli, Director Pei Yingzhang said: “In the temple the empresses are arrayed above; for ministers of another surname the rites should avoid suspicion.

sentences.zh: 且至尊拜俯於下，諸臣之靈亦必不安。

translations.literal: Moreover, when the supreme sovereign bows prostrate below, the spirits of the ministers too must be ill at ease.
translations.idiomatic: Moreover, when the supreme sovereign bows prostrate below, the spirits of the ministers too must be ill at ease.

sentences.zh: 」命復改西廡，遣官分獻。

translations.literal: ” Orders were given to change back to the west wing and dispatch officials for divided offerings.
translations.idiomatic: Orders were given to change back to the west wing and dispatch officials for divided offerings.

sentences.zh: 天啓元年，太常少卿李宗延言：「前代文臣皆有從祀。

translations.literal: In the first year of Tianqi, Vice Minister Li Zongyan said: “Former dynasties all had civil ministers in attendant sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: In the first year of Tianqi, Vice Minister Li Zongyan said: “Former dynasties all had civil ministers in attendant sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 我朝不宜獨闕。

translations.literal: Our dynasty should not alone be deficient.
translations.idiomatic: Our dynasty should not alone be deficient.

sentences.zh: 」下禮部議，不行。

translations.literal: ” It was sent down to the Ministry of Rites for deliberation; it was not carried out.
translations.idiomatic: It was sent down to the Ministry of Rites for deliberation; it was not carried out.

sentences.zh: ○王國宗廟

translations.literal: ○ Ancestral temples of princely states
translations.idiomatic: ○ Ancestral temples of princely states

sentences.zh: 洪武四年，禮部尚書陶凱等議定，王國宮垣內，左宗廟，右社稷。

translations.literal: In the fourth year of Hongwu, Minister of Rites Tao Kai and others deliberated and fixed that within the princely palace walls the ancestral temple should be on the left and the altar of soil and grain on the right.
translations.idiomatic: In the fourth year of Hongwu, Minister of Rites Tao Kai and others deliberated and fixed that within the princely palace walls the ancestral temple should be on the left and the altar of soil and grain on the right.

sentences.zh: 廟制，殿五間，寢殿如之，門三間。

translations.literal: The temple system: a hall of five bays, a sleeping hall to match, and a gate of three bays.
translations.idiomatic: The temple system: a hall of five bays, a sleeping hall to match, and a gate of three bays.

sentences.zh: 永樂八年，建秦愍王享堂，命視晉恭王制，加高一尺。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Yongle, the offering hall of Prince Min of Qin was built, ordered to follow the system of Prince Gong of Jin, with height increased by one chi.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Yongle, the offering hall of Prince Min of Qin was built, ordered to follow the system of Prince Gong of Jin, with height increased by one chi.

sentences.zh: 因定享堂七間，廣十丈九尺五寸，高二丈九尺，深四丈三尺五寸。

translations.literal: The offering hall was then fixed at seven bays, ten zhang nine chi five cun in width, two zhang nine chi in height, and four zhang three chi five cun in depth.
translations.idiomatic: The offering hall was then fixed at seven bays, ten zhang nine chi five cun in width, two zhang nine chi in height, and four zhang three chi five cun in depth.

sentences.zh: 弘治十三年，寧王宸濠奏廟祀禮樂未有定式，乞頒賜遵守。

translations.literal: In the thirteenth year of Hongzhi, Prince of Ning Zhu Chenhao memorialized that temple sacrifice music and rites had no fixed form and requested promulgation for observance.
translations.idiomatic: In the thirteenth year of Hongzhi, Prince of Ning Zhu Chenhao memorialized that temple sacrifice music and rites had no fixed form and requested promulgation for observance.

sentences.zh: 禮部議：「洪武元年，學士宋濂等奏定諸王國祭祀禮樂，用清字，但有曲名，而無曲辭，請各王府稽考。

translations.literal: The Ministry of Rites deliberated: “In the first year of Hongwu, Academician Song Lian and others memorialized fixing the sacrifice music and rites of princely states, using Qing-mode tunes; there were tune names but no lyrics—each princely mansion should investigate.
translations.idiomatic: The Ministry of Rites deliberated: “In the first year of Hongwu, Academician Song Lian and others memorialized fixing the sacrifice music and rites of princely states, using Qing-mode tunes; there were tune names but no lyrics—each princely mansion should investigate.

sentences.zh: 於是靖江王長史具上樂章，且言四孟上旬及除夕五祭所用品物、俎豆、佾舞，禮節悉遵國初定制。

translations.literal: Thereupon the Prince of Jingjiang’s chief steward fully submitted the music sections, and stated that the five sacrifices of the first ten days of the four meng months and New Year’s Eve—the items, stands, dancers, and rites—all followed the founding regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Thereupon the Prince of Jingjiang’s chief steward fully submitted the music sections, and stated that the five sacrifices of the first ten days of the four meng months and New Year’s Eve—the items, stands, dancers, and rites—all followed the founding regulations.

sentences.zh: 」從之。

translations.literal: ” Approval was given.
translations.idiomatic: Approval was given.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖八年，秦王充燿言：「代懿王當祔廟，而自始封至今，已盈五廟之數，請定祧廟之制。

translations.literal: In the eighth year of Jiajing, Prince of Qin Zhu Chongyao said: “Prince Yi of Dai should be enshrined in the temple; from the first enfeoffment until now the five temples are already full—we request fixing the system for removed-temple storage.
translations.idiomatic: In the eighth year of Jiajing, Prince of Qin Zhu Chongyao said: “Prince Yi of Dai should be enshrined in the temple; from the first enfeoffment until now the five temples are already full—we request fixing the system for removed-temple storage.

sentences.zh: 」禮臣言：「親王祧廟，古制未聞，宜推太廟祧祔之禮而降殺之。

translations.literal: ” The ritual ministers said: “Removed temples for imperial princes are not heard of in ancient institutions; one should extend the Grand Temple’s removal and enshrinement rites and reduce them in scale.
translations.idiomatic: ” The ritual ministers said: “Removed temples for imperial princes are not heard of in ancient institutions; one should extend the Grand Temple’s removal and enshrinement rites and reduce them in scale.

sentences.zh: 始封居中，百世不遷，以下四世，親盡而祧。

translations.literal: The founding enfeoffment remains in the center and is never moved for a hundred generations; below that four generations, and when kinship is exhausted they are removed from the line.
translations.idiomatic: The founding enfeoffment remains in the center and is never moved for a hundred generations; below that four generations, and when kinship is exhausted they are removed from the line.

sentences.zh: 但諸侯無祧廟，祧主宜祔始祖之室，置櫝藏之，每歲暮則出祧主合祭。

translations.literal: But feudal lords have no removed temple; removed tablets should be enshrined in the founding ancestor’s chamber, placed in a casket and stored; at each year’s end the removed tablets are taken out for joint sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: But feudal lords have no removed temple; removed tablets should be enshrined in the founding ancestor’s chamber, placed in a casket and stored; at each year’s end the removed tablets are taken out for joint sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 」詔如議。

translations.literal: ” An edict followed the deliberation.
translations.idiomatic: An edict followed the deliberation.

sentences.zh: ○羣臣家廟

translations.literal: ○ Family temples of officials
translations.idiomatic: ○ Family temples of officials

sentences.zh: 明初未有定制，權仿硃子祠堂之制，奉高曾祖禰四世神主，以四仲之月祭之，加臘月忌日之祭與歲時俗節之薦。

translations.literal: At the beginning of Ming there was no fixed regulation; provisionally imitating Zhu Xi’s ancestral-hall system, spirit tablets of four generations—great-great-grandfather through father—were received, sacrificed to in the four zhong months, with added sacrifice on the twelfth month death anniversary and seasonal folk festival offerings.
translations.idiomatic: At the beginning of Ming there was no fixed regulation; provisionally imitating Zhu Xi’s ancestral-hall system, spirit tablets of four generations—great-great-grandfather through father—were received, sacrificed to in the four zhong months, with added sacrifice on the twelfth month death anniversary and seasonal folk festival offerings.

sentences.zh: 其庶人得奉祖父母、父母之祀，已著爲令。

translations.literal: That commoners might sacrifice to grandparents and parents was already established as law.
translations.idiomatic: That commoners might sacrifice to grandparents and parents was already established as law.

sentences.zh: 至時享於寢之禮，略同品官祠堂之制。

translations.literal: As for the rite of seasonal offerings in the sleeping quarters, it broadly followed the ranked-official ancestral-hall system.
translations.idiomatic: As for the rite of seasonal offerings in the sleeping quarters, it broadly followed the ranked-official ancestral-hall system.

sentences.zh: 堂三間，兩階三級，中外爲兩門。

translations.literal: The hall had three bays, two flights of three steps, and inner and outer double gates.
translations.idiomatic: The hall had three bays, two flights of three steps, and inner and outer double gates.

sentences.zh: 堂設四龕，龕置一桌。

translations.literal: The hall had four niches, each niche with one table.
translations.idiomatic: The hall had four niches, each niche with one table.

sentences.zh: 高祖居西，以次而東，藏主櫝中。

translations.literal: The great-great-grandfather was on the west, proceeding east in order; tablets were stored in caskets.
translations.idiomatic: The great-great-grandfather was on the west, proceeding east in order; tablets were stored in caskets.

sentences.zh: 兩壁立櫃，西藏遺書衣物，東藏祭器。

translations.literal: Cabinets stood on both walls: on the west were stored books and clothing left behind; on the east sacrificial vessels.
translations.idiomatic: Cabinets stood on both walls: on the west were stored books and clothing left behind; on the east sacrificial vessels.

sentences.zh: 旁親無後者，以其班附。

translations.literal: Collateral kin without posterity were attached according to their generation rank.
translations.idiomatic: Collateral kin without posterity were attached according to their generation rank.

sentences.zh: 庶人無祠堂，以二代神主置居室中間，無櫝。

translations.literal: Commoners had no ancestral hall; tablets of two generations were placed in the middle of the dwelling, without caskets.
translations.idiomatic: Commoners had no ancestral hall; tablets of two generations were placed in the middle of the dwelling, without caskets.

sentences.zh: 洪武六年，定公侯以下家廟禮儀。

translations.literal: In the sixth year of Hongwu, the family-temple rites for dukes, marquises, and below were fixed.
translations.idiomatic: In the sixth year of Hongwu, the family-temple rites for dukes, marquises, and below were fixed.

sentences.zh: 凡公侯品官，別爲祠屋三間於所居之東，以祀高曾祖考，並祔位。

translations.literal: All dukes, marquises, and ranked officials separately built a shrine of three bays to the east of their residence to sacrifice to great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father, together with enshrined collateral places.
translations.idiomatic: All dukes, marquises, and ranked officials separately built a shrine of three bays to the east of their residence to sacrifice to great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father, together with enshrined collateral places.

sentences.zh: 祠堂未備，奉主於中堂享祭。

translations.literal: If the ancestral hall was not yet ready, tablets were received in the central hall for sacrifice.
translations.idiomatic: If the ancestral hall was not yet ready, tablets were received in the central hall for sacrifice.

sentences.zh: 二品以上，羊一豕一，五品以上，羊一，以下豕一，皆分四體熟薦。

translations.literal: Second rank and above: one sheep and one pig; fifth rank and above: one sheep; below that one pig—all divided into four portions and presented cooked.
translations.idiomatic: Second rank and above: one sheep and one pig; fifth rank and above: one sheep; below that one pig—all divided into four portions and presented cooked.

sentences.zh: 不能具牲者，設饌以享。

translations.literal: Those unable to provide sacrificial animals set out viands for the offering.
translations.idiomatic: Those unable to provide sacrificial animals set out viands for the offering.

sentences.zh: 所用器皿，隨官品第，稱家有無。

translations.literal: Vessels used followed official rank in descending order, according to what the household could afford.
translations.idiomatic: Vessels used followed official rank in descending order, according to what the household could afford.

sentences.zh: 前二日，主祭者聞於上，免朝參。

translations.literal: Two days beforehand, the chief sacrificer reported upward and was excused from court attendance.
translations.idiomatic: Two days beforehand, the chief sacrificer reported upward and was excused from court attendance.

sentences.zh: 凡祭，擇四仲吉日，或春、秋分，冬、夏至。

translations.literal: For all sacrifices, an auspicious day of the four zhong months was chosen, or spring or autumn equinox, winter or summer solstice.
translations.idiomatic: For all sacrifices, an auspicious day of the four zhong months was chosen, or spring or autumn equinox, winter or summer solstice.

sentences.zh: 前期一日，齋沐更衣，宿外舍。

translations.literal: One day beforehand, one bathed, changed clothes, and lodged in an outer lodging.
translations.idiomatic: One day beforehand, one bathed, changed clothes, and lodged in an outer lodging.

sentences.zh: 質明，主祭者及婦率預祭者詣祠堂。

translations.literal: At dawn, the chief sacrificer and his wife led those participating in the sacrifice to the ancestral hall.
translations.idiomatic: At dawn, the chief sacrificer and his wife led those participating in the sacrifice to the ancestral hall.

sentences.zh: 主祭者捧正祔神主櫝，置於盤，令子弟捧至祭所。

translations.literal: The chief sacrificer bore the casket of the principal and enshrined collateral spirit tablets, placed it on a tray, and ordered younger kinsmen to bear it to the sacrifice place.
translations.idiomatic: The chief sacrificer bore the casket of the principal and enshrined collateral spirit tablets, placed it on a tray, and ordered younger kinsmen to bore it to the sacrifice place.

sentences.zh: 主祭開櫝，捧各祖妣神主，以序奉安。

translations.literal: The chief sacrificer opened the casket and bore each ancestral spirit tablet, installing them in order.
translations.idiomatic: The chief sacrificer opened the casket and bore each ancestral spirit tablet, installing them in order.

sentences.zh: 子弟捧祔主，置東西壁。

translations.literal: Younger kinsmen bore the enshrined collateral tablets and placed them on the east and west walls.
translations.idiomatic: Younger kinsmen bore the enshrined collateral tablets and placed them on the east and west walls.

sentences.zh: 執事者進饌，讀祝者一人，就贊禮，以子弟親族爲之。

translations.literal: Attendants presented the viands; one person read the prayer, standing in for the ritual invoker, drawn from younger kinsmen and agnates.
translations.idiomatic: Attendants presented the viands; one person read the prayer, standing in for the ritual invoker, drawn from younger kinsmen and agnates.

sentences.zh: 陳設神位訖，各就位，主祭在東，伯叔諸兄立於其前稍東，諸親立於其後，主婦在西，母及諸母立於其前稍西，婦女立於後。

translations.literal: When the spirit seats were set out, each took position: the chief sacrificer on the east, paternal uncles and elder brothers standing before him slightly to the east, other kin behind; the chief wife on the west, mothers and aunts before her slightly to the west, women behind.
translations.idiomatic: When the spirit seats were set out, each took position: the chief sacrificer on the east, paternal uncles and elder brothers standing before him slightly to the east, other kin behind; the chief wife on the west, mothers and aunts before her slightly to the west, women behind.

sentences.zh: 贊拜，皆再拜。

translations.literal: The invoker praised bowing; all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The invoker praised bowing; all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 主祭者詣香案前跪，三上香，獻酒奠酒，執事酌酒於祔位前。

translations.literal: The chief sacrificer went before the incense table and knelt, offered incense three times, presented wine and poured libations; attendants poured wine before the enshrined collateral places.
translations.idiomatic: The chief sacrificer went before the incense table and knelt, offered incense three times, presented wine and poured libations; attendants poured wine before the enshrined collateral places.

sentences.zh: 讀祝者跪讀訖，贊拜，主祭者復位，與主婦皆再拜。

translations.literal: The prayer reader knelt and finished reading; the invoker praised bowing; the chief sacrificer returned to position and together with the chief wife all bowed twice.
translations.idiomatic: The prayer reader knelt and finished reading; the invoker praised bowing; the chief sacrificer returned to position and together with the chief wife all bowed twice.

sentences.zh: 再獻終獻並如之，惟不讀祝。

translations.literal: The second and final offerings were the same, only without reading the prayer.
translations.idiomatic: The second and final offerings were the same, only without reading the prayer.

sentences.zh: 每獻，執事者亦獻於祔位。

translations.literal: At each offering, attendants also offered at the enshrined collateral places.
translations.idiomatic: At each offering, attendants also offered at the enshrined collateral places.

sentences.zh: 禮畢，再拜，焚祝並紙錢於中庭，安神主於櫝。

translations.literal: When the rite was finished, all bowed twice, burned the prayer and paper money in the central courtyard, and returned the spirit tablets to the caskets.
translations.idiomatic: When the rite was finished, all bowed twice, burned the prayer and paper money in the central courtyard, and returned the spirit tablets to the caskets.

sentences.zh: 成化十一年，祭酒周洪謨言：「臣庶祠堂神主，俱自西而東。

translations.literal: In the eleventh year of Chenghua, Director of the Imperial Academy Zhou Hongmo said: “Official and commoner ancestral-hall spirit tablets are all from west to east.
translations.idiomatic: In the eleventh year of Chenghua, Director of the Imperial Academy Zhou Hongmo said: “Official and commoner ancestral-hall spirit tablets are all from west to east.

sentences.zh: 古無神道尚右之說，惟我太祖廟制，合先王左昭右穆之義。

translations.literal: In antiquity there is no saying that the spirit way honors the right; only our Taizu’s temple system conforms to the former kings’ meaning of zhao on the left and mu on the right.
translations.idiomatic: In antiquity there is no saying that the spirit way honors the right; only our Taizu’s temple system conforms to the former kings’ meaning of zhao on the left and mu on the right.

sentences.zh: 宜令一品至九品，皆立一廟，以高卑廣狹爲殺。

translations.literal: First through ninth ranks should all establish one temple, with breadth and narrowness reduced according to high and low station.
translations.idiomatic: First through ninth ranks should all establish one temple, with breadth and narrowness reduced according to high and low station.

sentences.zh: 神主則高祖居左，曾祖居右，祖居次左，考居次右。

translations.literal: Spirit tablets should have the great-great-grandfather on the left, great-grandfather on the right, grandfather next left, and father next right.
translations.idiomatic: Spirit tablets should have the great-great-grandfather on the left, great-grandfather on the right, grandfather next left, and father next right.

sentences.zh: 」帝下禮臣參酌更定。

translations.literal: ” The emperor sent it down to ritual ministers for deliberation and revision.
translations.idiomatic: The emperor sent it down to ritual ministers for deliberation and revision.

sentences.zh: 嘉靖十五年，禮部尚書夏言言：「按三代有五廟、三廟、二廟、一廟之制者，以其有諸侯、卿、大夫上中下之爵也。

translations.literal: In the fifteenth year of Jiajing, Minister of Rites Xia Yan said: “Examining the three dynasties, there were systems of five temples, three temples, two temples, and one temple because there were ranks of feudal lord, minister, grandee, and upper, middle, and lower officials.
translations.idiomatic: In the fifteenth year of Jiajing, Minister of Rites Xia Yan said: “Examining the three dynasties, there were systems of five temples, three temples, two temples, and one temple because there were ranks of feudal lord, minister, grandee, and upper, middle, and lower officials.

sentences.zh: 後世官職既殊，無世封采邑，豈宜過泥於古。

translations.literal: Later generations’ offices differ; there are no hereditary fiefs and estates—how can one rigidly adhere to antiquity.
translations.idiomatic: Later generations’ offices differ; there are no hereditary fiefs and estates—how can one rigidly adhere to antiquity.

sentences.zh: 至宋儒程頤乃始約之而歸於四世，自公卿以及士庶，莫不皆然。

translations.literal: Only the Song Confucian Cheng Yi began to reduce it and return it to four generations; from dukes and ministers down to scholars and commoners, none differed.
translations.idiomatic: Only the Song Confucian Cheng Yi began to reduce it and return it to four generations; from dukes and ministers down to scholars and commoners, none differed.

sentences.zh: 謂五服之制，皆至高祖，則祭亦當如之。

translations.literal: He held that because the five-garment mourning system all reaches to the great-great-grandfather, sacrifice should likewise do so.
translations.idiomatic: He held that because the five-garment mourning system all reaches to the great-great-grandfather, sacrifice should likewise do so.

sentences.zh: 今定官自三品以上立五廟，以下皆四廟。

translations.literal: Now it is fixed that officials of third rank and above establish five temples; all below establish four temples.
translations.idiomatic: Now it is fixed that officials of third rank and above establish five temples; all below establish four temples.

sentences.zh: 爲五廟者，亦如唐制。

translations.literal: Those with five temples likewise follow Tang regulations.
translations.idiomatic: Those with five temples likewise follow Tang regulations.

sentences.zh: 五間九架，廈旁隔板爲五室，中祔五世祖，旁四室，祔高曾祖禰。

translations.literal: Five bays and nine frames, with side partitions forming five chambers; the founding ancestor of five generations is enshrined in the center, and the four side chambers enshrine great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.
translations.idiomatic: Five bays and nine frames, with side partitions forming five chambers; the founding ancestor of five generations is enshrined in the center, and the four side chambers enshrine great-great-grandfather, great-grandfather, grandfather, and father.

sentences.zh: 爲四廟者，三間五架，中一室祔高曾，左右二室祔祖禰。

translations.literal: Those with four temples have three bays and five frames; the central chamber enshrines great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather, and the left and right chambers enshrine grandfather and father.
translations.idiomatic: Those with four temples have three bays and five frames; the central chamber enshrines great-great-grandfather and great-grandfather, and the left and right chambers enshrine grandfather and father.

sentences.zh: 若當祀始祖，則如硃熹所云，臨祭時，作紙牌，祭訖焚之。

translations.literal: If the founding ancestor is to be sacrificed to, then as Zhu Xi said, at the time of sacrifice a paper tablet is made and burned when the sacrifice is finished.
translations.idiomatic: If the founding ancestor is to be sacrificed to, then as Zhu Xi said, at the time of sacrifice a paper tablet is made and burned when the sacrifice is finished.

sentences.zh: 其三品以上者，至世數窮盡，則以今之得立廟者爲世世奉祀之祖，而不遷焉。

translations.literal: For those of third rank and above, when generations are exhausted, the one who may now establish a temple becomes the founding ancestor sacrificed to in perpetuity and is not moved.
translations.idiomatic: For those of third rank and above, when generations are exhausted, the one who may now establish a temple becomes the founding ancestor sacrificed to in perpetuity and is not moved.

sentences.zh: 四品以下，四世遞遷而已。

translations.literal: Fourth rank and below simply rotate through four generations.
translations.idiomatic: Fourth rank and below simply rotate through four generations.
